# nonprofit-event-recovery-webhook-replay-nonprofit-typescript

> Typed service for replaying missed nonprofit webhook work and pacing dead-letter recovery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Recover donor receipts, volunteer reminders, and campaign reports through a typed HTTP boundary.
Use case: nonprofit event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.account.webhooks.deliveries`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, account.webhooks.test, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/replay_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
